correctness.rationale: For each m=1..5, enumerating both source W_m and all one-zero/one-one outputs gives an exact compatibility graph. Clique/code equivalence follows immediately from disjoint deletion shadows. A proper greedy coloring bounds clique extensions and exhaustive recursive branching enumerates all codes of target size and eliminates target+1 without heuristic steps. The bundled Python 3 checker replays all 666 length-ten maxima, confirms no size-eleven code and all symmetry orbits; a separately formulated integer optimization also agrees on the optimum sizes. No finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Motivated zero-error coding with composition constraints and known opposite-symbol deletions. The exhaustive small-length classification includes exact optima, counts of all optimum codebooks, a symmetry orbit spectrum and a concrete optimal length-ten construction. The conditional channel differs materially from unrestricted two-deletion correction; a finite exact benchmark can guide code design without requiring a general asymptotic theorem. The cutoff is stated explicitly and does not follow merely from generic graph-model definitions.
